name: South Bay Youth One Stop (work experience and STEP)
what_you_do: Free job training, work experience and internships. You also get skill training and help finding a job. STEP gives work experience for your resume and applications.
who_can_apply: Youth and young adults ages 14 to 24, in or out of school. Residency and income rules are not stated.
pay_detail: STEP says you can earn money but gives no amount. Other pay is not stated.
deadline_text: No deadlines listed. A Youth Job Fair is linked but no date is on the page.
how_to_apply: Use the Sign Up Here form. Or contact a job coordinator in your area. Or call the Inglewood office at 310.680.3700.
notes: Teen Centers for ages 13 to 17 (Inglewood Mon to Thu 3 to 6 PM, Hawthorne Mon to Fri 3 to 6 PM) are listed too but are not job programs. Bridge to Work is for foster youth only. The page does not mention work permits. California requires a permit for paid work under 18.
